messages:
devon: Heads up — seeing sustained p99 egress queuing on eu-west racks when dedicated slices hand off to shared egress. Dedicated tenants report tail latency spikes.

maria: When did this start? any rolling changes? :thinking:

devon: Spikes started ~02:10 UTC. No infra deploys, but routing controller logs show repeated slice-handoff events + dropped tokens. Snippet:```2026-03-20T02:11:03Z slice=dedicated-az3 tenant=t-42 event=handoff queued=120 iface=eth2 qlen=4800```

ash: Looks like soft-buffer credits are getting depleted during handoff, then requests get punted to cross-az egress. That accounts for +30-60ms and queuing.

sam: Do we have telemetry on soft-buffer consumption per-tenant? Can we confirm threshold hit?

devon: Yes — telemetry shows a sharp credit drop at handoff for 3 tenants. Chart: soft_buf[t-42] goes from 800 -> 0 in ~6s under steady request rate.

maria: If routing fallback is cross-az, cost goes up (egress + inter-AZ transfer). We should quantify cost vs latency to argue mitigation path.

ash: Short term mitigation idea: add a small grace refill on handoff to prevent immediate fallback (e.g., +200 tokens) and route to a burst lane with a per-tenant cap.

sam: Agreed. Proposal sketch: prefer intra-az egress, on handoff provide prefill window and burst-lane token cap. If burst-lane exhausts, then fallback to cross-az. Config prototype:```routing:
  prefer: intra_az_egress
  prefill_window_ms: 200
  prefill_tokens: 200
  burst_lane_tokens: 500
  burst_token_ttl_s: 60
  fallback: cross_az_burst
```

maria: Cost note: if several heavy tenants use burst lane consistently we'll burn inter-AZ and egress costs. Rough estimate: +$2.5-4k/mo for eu-west per offending tenant at current traffic. Need budget signoff if we keep burst lane open.

devon: Can we do a cheap canary? Enable prefill for 5% of handoffs in eu-west-az3 and monitor p99 + egress bytes. Rollback if egress delta > 15%.

infra-bot: canary-controller: canary started on eu-west-az3 -> 5% tenants at 2026-03-20T03:00:00Z.

sam: I'll watch APM and tail-latency dashboards. Threshold: p99>200ms => abort and revert.

ash: Add an opt-out for enterprise dedicated customers who don't want cross-az egress for compliance. Also ensure KMS/HSM traffic still pins.

maria: Runbook please: steps to disable burst-lane and to revert routing weights. Also include cost dashboard link.

devon: I made a short checklist and runbook draft, pushing to infra-runbooks: <https://internal/runbooks/egress-handoff-prefill>. Short steps included.

ash: One more check — NVMe-backed KV cache regen during handoff can also spike egress if we miss prefix cache. Ensure kvcache warmup disabled on immediate handoff.

devon: Good call. I'll add a pre-warm check: if kvcache_miss_rate>5% then hold handoff for 200ms to allow cache warming.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: routing-controller:v2.8.1 canary rolled to eu-west-az3 (5%).

sam: :eyes: monitoring. If we see improvement we'll expand to az2 at 20% and then full eu-west.

maria: Also put a note to finance for a temporary egress estimate (2-week window) so we can approve burst-lane spend if needed.

devon: Thanks team — I'll post a short postmortem if canary shows regressions. For now watchers: @sam @maria @ash.

sam: 👍 will update in 30m with initial metrics.
